description: Header file defining interfaces, constants, and data structures for the STM32F10x CEC (Consumer Electronics Control) peripheral driver.

methods.name: CEC_DeInit
methods.description: De-initializes the CEC peripheral registers to their default reset values.

methods.name: CEC_Init
methods.description: Initializes the CEC peripheral with specified configuration parameters.

methods.name: CEC_Cmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the CEC peripheral.

methods.name: CEC_OwnAddressConfig
methods.description: Sets the own address for the CEC peripheral.

methods.name: CEC_SetPrescaler
methods.description: Sets the prescaler value for the CEC clock.

methods.name: CEC_SendDataByte
methods.description: Sends a data byte over CEC.

methods.name: CEC_ReceiveDataByte
methods.description: Receives a data byte from CEC.

methods.name: CEC_GetFlagStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of a CEC flag.

methods.name: CEC_GetITStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of a CEC interrupt.
